origin.title: How we started
origin.text: Alma Serena was born in 2016, when two therapists from Morelia opened a small massage room in the historic center with a simple idea: taking care of yourself shouldn't feel like a distant luxury. Today our purpose is still the same: to give our community a warm, honest place to slow down, heal and go home a little calmer.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.imageAlt: Body ritual with fruit, flowers and oils on a Talavera tile floor
paragraphs: We believe rest isn't a luxury but a way of caring for yourself. Alma Serena was born as a refuge where time slows down just enough to listen to the body.
Every treatment blends contemporary techniques with the traditional knowledge of Michoacán: local plants, clay, oils and the unhurried pace of doing things with intention.
We don't follow clock-driven protocols. We listen first, recommend second, and tailor each session to what you need that day.

promise.quote: That you leave here breathing differently than when you arrived: slower, deeper, more yourself.
promise.caption: Our promise

values.title: Our values
values.subtitle: What guides every treatment, every day

mindful-care.title: Mindful care
mindful-care.description: We care for the whole person, not just the symptom. Every session starts with a short conversation to understand how you're arriving.

local-roots.title: Local roots
local-roots.description: We work with Michoacán growers of herbs, honey and clays, and showcase local women artisans in our spaces.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: We use biodegradable products, organic cotton linens and a rainwater collection system for our hydrotherapy.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Clear prices, no surprise charges, and honest recommendations: if a treatment isn't right for you, we'll tell you.

growing-team.title: A team that grows
growing-team.description: Our therapists receive ongoing training and fair pay, because a team that is cared for cares better.

safe-spaces.title: Safe spaces
safe-spaces.description: A respectful, inclusive environment where each person sets the pace, the pressure and how much to talk.

items.2016: We opened a small massage room in Morelia's historic center.
items.2019: We moved to Jardines del Lago and added facials and body rituals.
items.2022: We opened the hydrotherapy area with a sauna and eucalyptus steam.
items.2025: Over 12,000 visits and a team of 14 certified therapists.
